shortDescription: Deliveries of low-sulphur gasoil (LGOc1) for September fell to 740 lots, or 74,000 metric tons, at expiry, down from 1,058 lots in August, Intercontinental Exchange data showed on Thursday.The contract expired at $1,464.00 a ton.
